pending_interview.question: A regional retail bank comes to you asking for help. They want to use AI to personalize which loan products are shown to customers who log into their mobile app. Their team has heard competitors are doing this and they don't want to fall behind. They have two years of transaction history, basic demographic data collected at account opening, and a small internal data team with no ML experience. They're asking you whether they should build this system themselves, buy a vendor solution, or work with your team to build it. Walk me through how you would scope this conversation with them and what you would want to know before giving a recommendation.
